segments.en: Join discussions at your own pace

segments.source: At Saturdays.AI we believe that we must accelerate our mission to make A.I. accessible to everyone. That is why we are launching our online community.
segments.en: At Saturdays.AI, we want to make AI accessible to everyone. Our online community helps us learn, share and connect beyond our own cities.
segments.es: En Saturdays.AI queremos acercar la IA a todas las personas. Nuestra comunidad en línea nos ayuda a aprender, compartir y conectar más allá de cada ciudad.

segments.source: Learning data science or machine learning is not easy, building awesome AI projects is even less. You need basic knowledge, motivation and peers to walk together in the process.
segments.en: Learning data science or machine learning is not easy, building awesome AI projects is even less. You need basic knowledge, motivation and peers to walk together in the process.
segments.es: Aprender ciencia de datos o aprendizaje automático no es fácil, y construir proyectos de IA asombrosos lo es aún menos. Necesitas conocimientos básicos, motivación y compañeros para caminar juntos en el proceso.
Por eso hemos creado la
comunidad en línea de Saturdays.AI

segments.source: – free of charge – so you can start discussions, ask your questions, share events or talks, search for job offers or create A.I. initiatives.
segments.en: – free of charge – so you can start discussions, ask your questions, share events or talks, search for job offers or create A.I. initiatives.

Acceso abierto

segments.source: You will be able to access state of the art online courses about AI, from learning python to prompt engineering, or even to train a custom LLM, bot for advanced and beginners, together with events and what is trending in the AI / ML world.
segments.en: Explore AI courses for different levels, from Python and prompt engineering to training language models. Discover events and developments in AI and machine learning too.
segments.es: Explora cursos de IA para distintos niveles: desde Python e ingeniería de prompts hasta el entrenamiento de modelos de lenguaje. Descubre también eventos y novedades sobre IA y aprendizaje automático.
